description.text: Program Introduction If you could finish the Preparatory Program and pass the graduation test based on the subjects taught during the Preparatory Program, and don’t have any record of violating laws of China and regulations of the college during the study, you will be admitted to M.B.B.S. Program, Master Program or Doctor Program in our college( Autumn Session of 2015 ). Main Courses Elementary Chinese,General Introduction of China,Introduction to Sociology, Medical Physics, Medical Chemistry, Medical Biology, Physical Education(Taiji), etc. The courses also include two trips organized by the university. Study Duration 7 months Fee Structure Registration fee: 75 USD Tuition fee: 12000 RMB Hostel fee: 2300/person (double room) Others: pay required fees to the acceptors when processing physical exam, residence permit and insurance. All fees are not refundable and their use can’t be changed.

duration.text: The Preparatory Program at Xuzhou Medical University is a 7 Months long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/In total ￥ 12000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: 1. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university 2. Be in good health 3. With reliable financial support and custody.
